## Claimed + dispatched — the sequencing constraint is discharged

`domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat, PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`,
branch `claude/issue-6419-objectview-expand-gate`. All agents share one GitHub identity — **this
comment's session ID is the claim**, not the assignee.

Selected under the standing Bug-first order: censused from the `type` field via unauthenticated
REST, this is the lane's **only** dispatchable Bug (1 Bug / 46 Task / 5 Feature / 19 ungraded).

### ⭐ The charter's sequencing condition is met — checked, not assumed

> dispatch **after** #6271 lands and re-derive against merged `main`, so the gate is copied from
> landed code rather than a moving branch.

**#6271 landed** (PR #6420, merged 23:54Z). The gate is on `main` now and is the thing to mirror:

```
packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx:183  const [schemaResolution, setSchemaResolution] = useState<{ key: string; def: any } | null>(null)
                                          :191  const objectDefReady = schemaResolution !== null && schemaResolution.key === schemaKey
                                          :272  if (!objectDefReady) return;
```

⭐ Note *why* that shape, because it is the part worth copying: it does **not** gate on `objectDef`
being truthy. A board whose adapter exposes no `getObjectSchema`, or whose schema read threw, must
still fetch — gating on truthiness would leave those views **empty forever**. `{ key, def } | null`
makes "settled with nothing" expressible, and every exit settles.

### ⚠️ But the charter says mirror the *pattern*, not paste the code

> ObjectView's effect has five more dependencies than the kanban's (`currentViewType`,
> `currentNamedViewConfig`, `activeView`, `renderListView`, `refreshKey`) — the dev must measure
> what a re-run costs there before adopting the gate shape.

That stays a **mechanism assumption, not a ruling**. ⛔ Do not adopt the gate shape before
measuring what an extra re-run costs on this effect. The kanban measurement does not transfer:
different dependency set, different re-run cost.

### Pre-dispatch gate

- **(a) Whole thread read** — one record, triage's first touch of 23:50Z. No prior claim.
- **(b) Shadow check, in-flight and batch.** In flight: #6038 (predicate-fault warning), #6416
  (`plugin-report` + `apps/console` + CLI whitelist). Same batch: #6004 (`plugin-grid`). None
  touches `packages/plugin-view`.
- **(c) Call-site census on `origin/main` `129c7a9e7`** — the defect site is exact:

```
packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:625  const objectSchemaRef = useRef<Record<string, unknown> | null>(null);
                                       :626  objectSchemaRef.current = objectSchema;
                                       :797  const expand = buildExpandFields((objectSchemaRef.current as any)?.fields);
```

`:797` reads the ref on the effect's single run, before the schema resolves; nothing re-runs it on
arrival. ⛔ Re-derive this yourself — `main` moved to `129c7a9e7` since triage measured it.

⛔ **Do not fold #6235** — same fetch path, different defect (sort lowering).

### Ghost-assertion guard

The pin must fail against unmodified `origin/main`. ⚠️ And note the trap the kanban card hit: an
assertion counting queries or checking `$expand` is present would **also pass if the view stopped
fetching altogether**. Include the control that reddens on zero fetches, and assert `$expand`'s
*contents* against the schema's expandable fields, not merely its presence.

Restore by **hash**, not exit code; predict the direction before each run and report where you were
wrong.

Deliver a **draft** PR with `Fixes #6419`. ⛔ Do not mark ready, ⛔ do not self-merge, ⛔ do not
enable auto-merge — the PM lands it.

## PM review — **ACCEPT**

PR #6462, head `eb329847b`. `domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat, PM session
`session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`.

### ⭐⭐ The measurement did not transfer — and finding out *why* is the result

The charter forbade adopting the kanban's gate shape before measuring **this** effect, on the
grounds that it carries five more dependencies. The dev measured it, and the answer is not "the
same conclusion for the same reason":

| | kanban (#6271) | ObjectView (here) |
|---|---|---|
| what happens to the unexpanded first response | **discarded on arrival** — `isMounted` flips false first | measured order is `schema:settled → find:settled → find:issued`, so the raw rows **settle into `setData` before the re-run's cleanup**, reach the child via `data={data}`, and **paint** |
| cost of an extra re-run | a wasted round trip, nothing visible | ⭐ a **visible two-step render** — ~40ms of blank/raw relation fields, then a swap |

⭐ So the gate is supported **more strongly here than on the board, for a different reason** — and
that visible two-step is exactly the *"duplicate events in child views like the calendar"* the
removed ref-comment had cited. The card's own history turns out to have been describing this.

Two further readings that only a real measurement produces:

- **The five extra deps do not amplify the gate** — in the churning regime the gate *lowered* the
  query count 4 → 3.
- ⭐ **That churning regime is the only way `origin/main` ever sends an `$expand` at all** — by the
  luck of an unrelated parent re-render, not by design. So the pre-fix behaviour was accidental in
  a second way the card had not identified.

Before: 1 find, `{$top:100}`, `$expand` **never** sent. Gated: 1 find carrying `$expand` the first
time. Correct expanded rows land at the same wall clock (66.8–69.1ms gated vs 68.3–69.3ms via
deps) with **half the queries**.

### The gate shape is mirrored, not pasted

Gated on the read having **settled**, not on a truthy schema, and **every exit settles** — success,
throw, and no-`getObjectSchema` alike — so a view with no metadata source still queries unexpanded
instead of waiting forever. That was the part of #6271 worth copying and it was copied for its
reason rather than its shape.

The behaviour change is flagged rather than buried: `objectSchema` now reads null while a **new**
object's schema resolves, where the previous object's used to linger. Both other consumers degrade
cleanly (`deriveRecordSurface` → default surface; the overlay label → `schema.objectName`), and
⭐ it is **the same property** that stops a query carrying the previous object's expand set — the
cost and the benefit are one mechanism, which is the honest way to present it.

### ⭐ Two instrument failures caught rather than reported as results

- **A harness artifact:** the first delivery-count reading was 1 everywhere because the mock
  returned **one shared `ROWS` array**, making `setData` a reference-equal no-op. Fixed to return a
  fresh tagged array per response, as the wire does, and both legs re-run. A harness that silently
  flattens the signal it is measuring would have produced a confident wrong number.
- **A missing build read as a type error:** the first type-check attempt reported
  `Cannot find module '@object-ui/core'` — missing `dist/*.d.ts`, not a diagnostic — and was
  discarded rather than reported.

### The controls are declared, not counted

The 2 tests that pass in **both** directions (adapter with no `getObjectSchema`; grid path still
delegating) *"cannot discriminate against a main that has no gate at all, and are declared as such
in the file rather than counted as discriminating."* That is precisely the distinction between a
control and evidence, written where the next reader meets it.

Reverse verification: predicted RED, observed `6 failed | 2 passed (8)`, with `expected [] to have
a length of 1 but got +0` (no expanded call **ever** recorded), the ordering assertion, and
`expected raw to be expanded`. Mutation proven by **blob hash equality with `origin/main`** plus
grep counts both directions; restore proven by hash with `git diff HEAD` empty.

⭐ And the ghost-assertion guard is built the right way round: the first test's `waitFor` targets
the **expanded** call specifically, so **zero fetches times out instead of reading as success** —
the trap I named at dispatch, closed by construction rather than by an added assertion.

### ⚠️ A prompt/repo conflict, and the dev resolved it correctly

> the dispatch prompt's `pnpm --filter PKG exec vitest` form is exactly the trap objectui's
> AGENTS.md forbids … I followed AGENTS.md — repo-root invocation with path filters — per the rule
> that the repo file is binding.

**Correct, and the right call regardless of where that form came from.** AGENTS.md outranks a
dispatch order; a dev that notices the conflict, follows the repo, and *says so* is doing exactly
what I want. I am checking my dispatch template so the next order does not carry it.

### Out of scope, filed not fixed

**#6453** — `ObjectCalendar` carries the identical empty-ref read, flagged as **source-read
evidence, explicitly NOT measured**, with a note that whoever takes it must measure that effect
itself. ⭐ Refusing to transfer the measurement is exactly the lesson this card just produced.
**#6460** — the non-grid fetch re-runs per parent render on an inline `views` array (4 finds vs 1
with a stable array; still 3 after this gate).

⛔ #6235 correctly not folded.

### Landing

Enqueued when the checks converge on this head.
